\section{Weekly Project Homework (Monday--Saturday)}\label{sec:homework}
\begin{navynote}
\textbf{\color{gold}How the week works.} Sunday teaches the method on a guided dataset; Monday to Saturday you apply it to a harder, real dataset as one portfolio project. Plan \textbf{2--3 hours a day} (about 15 hours a week). Commit every day, then tag \texttt{week-N} and create a GitHub Release by \textbf{Saturday 23:59 local time}. Mentors review every release before the next Sunday and open the class with common mistakes. Full daily task lists, acceptance checks and stretch goals are in each week's \texttt{HOMEWORK.md} and at the end of that Sunday's student notes.
\end{navynote}

\textbf{Tue} & \textbf{Transfer learning versus training from scratch.} See what pretraining buys. & \texttt{notebooks/02\_transfer.ipynb} with curves and a comparison table & Same data, epochs and seed for both runs; macro-F1 reported. & 3 h\\
\textbf{Wed} & \textbf{Modern backbones and mixed precision.} Compare architectures fairly. & Comparison table and confusion matrix in \texttt{reports/backbones.md} & All three models compared on identical splits; costs (time, memory) reported next to accuracy. & 3 h\\
\textbf{Thu} & \textbf{Robustness on real field photos.} Measure and close the lab-to-field gap. & \texttt{reports/robustness.md} with before/after tables and the Grad-CAM gallery & Lab vs field accuracy reported for both training recipes; failure causes categorised. & 3 h\\
\textbf{Fri} & \textbf{Calibration, quantisation and edge deployment.} Make it small, fast and honest about uncertainty. & \texttt{models/leafdoctor\_int8.onnx}, \texttt{reports/deploy.md} & ECE before and after scaling; latency table; INT8 accuracy within 1 point of FP32 or explained. & 2--3 h\\
\textbf{Sat} & \textbf{Demo app and model card.} Ship it. & App, model card, demo link, Release \texttt{week-2} & App works on a phone photo; model card states field accuracy, not only lab accuracy. & 3 h\\
\end{tabularx}}
